_what: Outbound call sites that deliberately do not send the workspace User-Agent (config/user-agent.txt). Read by scripts/check-user-agent.py, which refuses an entry that matches no site. Every entry says why; the operator's rule of 2026-09-27 is one value everywhere the workspace talks to the outside world, so an entry here must be a call that is NOT the outside world or one where the value would do harm.

exemptions.reason: Attaches over CDP to the operator's own dedicated Brave. That browser already sends a real Chrome-family User-Agent with matching client hints; overriding only the string creates a mismatch that marks automation.

Approved by the operator on 2026-10-16 (engine audit). Launches the operator's own Brave binary (or, opt-in, bundled Chromium) carrying his LinkedIn session cookies, and sends the User-Agent that browser itself reports, headless marker removed, in both the page context and the pre-flight probe. The fixed Windows string would contradict the browser's own client hints and platform on this Linux machine, the same mismatch that exempts the dedicated Brave, and LinkedIn invalidates a session on signals of this kind.
Same decision as main in this file: the pre-flight must send the same string as the browser that holds the session.
